name: backend-roadmap
description: Backend Roadmap — curriculum content, the React app (webapp/) and its API (api/, on Cloudflare Pages Functions)

scripts.build: npm --prefix webapp run build && npm run index && node scripts/build/copy-content.cjs && node scripts/build/prerender.mjs
scripts.index: python scripts/build/gen-docs-index.py && python scripts/build/gen-search-index.py && node scripts/build/gen-site-stats.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/check/check-admin-guards.js && node scripts/check/check-paths.mjs && node scripts/check/check-images.mjs
